facts.fact: Algerie360 reports the Dzair Digital Services portal, launched 5 July 2026, carried 71 digital services for citizens and gained 20 tourism and handicraft services announced by the High Commission for Digitalisation on 16 November 2026.

Algerie360 cites a High Commission for Digitalisation expert saying the portal had nearly two million registered users, 11 million visits and over 900,000 documents downloaded four months after launch.
